codex.delegation: Use only native subagent invocation exposed by the active Codex session.

surfaces: GitHub.com custom agent assignment (no subagent delegation)
copilot.delegation: Surface-dependent; probe the active Copilot host. GitHub.com custom agents do not imply subagent support.

claude-code.delegation: Use the native Agent mechanism only when exposed and authorized.

cursor.delegation: Use native Cursor subagents in Editor, CLI, or Cloud Agents only when exposed and authorized.

installer_policy.instruction_files: Merge ecosystem instructions inside explicit managed markers for Codex, Copilot, and Claude Code; install the Cursor MDC rule as a separate exclusively managed file so required frontmatter remains at the start of the file.
installer_policy.agent_and_skill_files: Never overwrite an existing unmanaged file with different content. Update only files recorded in .agent-ecosystem/adapters/<adapter>.json.
installer_policy.uninstall: Remove only registered managed files, merged instruction blocks, and the exclusively managed Cursor MDC rule. Preserve unrelated project files and project memory.
installer_policy.dry_run: Must not create or modify any project file.

capability_policy.tool_names: Do not copy Antigravity tool names or allowlists into other platform manifests.
capability_policy.permissions: Generated profiles do not grant host permissions, shell access, MCP connectivity, or approval rights.
capability_policy.verification: Run real read, write, terminal, MCP, and delegation probes separately in each target runtime and surface.

claude_code.metadata_directory_policy: Only plugin.json and marketplace.json; no component subdirectories.

cursor.metadata_directory_policy: Only plugin.json and marketplace.json; no component subdirectories.

codex.note: Codex rejects repository-root marketplace sources and its plugin manifest does not define agents/rules components. The minimal skills-only subdirectory package is required; Codex agent profiles are installed separately through .codex/agents.

shared_plugin_bundle.note: Claude Code and Cursor reference the root bundle directly. Codex requires a strict subdirectory source, so only its supported skills component is mirrored under plugins/ai-agent/; Codex agent profiles remain in the native .codex/agents adapter.
